idea-plugin.name: comp1337
idea-plugin.description: comp1337 ("comp elite") provides locally deployed LLM code completions in PyCharm: ghost-text inline suggestions served by a fill-in-the-middle model on your own machine. Talks to a loopback-only server — LM Studio or Ollama (/v1/completions) or llama.cpp llama-server (/infill). Mayday (French venez m'aider, "come help me") for when Copilot is too slow. Nothing leaves your machine.
